description_en: Searches for resources across the management account and multiple member accounts in a resource directory
description_zh: 搜索资源目录管理账号和多个成员中的资源
name: SearchMultiAccountResources

parameters.help_en:
The scope of accounts to search. Valid values: 
Resource directory ID: searches for resources across the management account and all member accounts. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159995.html.
Root folder ID: searches for resources across all member accounts in the Root folder and its subfolders. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html.
Folder ID: searches for resources across all member accounts in the specified folder. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html.
Member account ID: searches for resources in the specified member account. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html
parameters.help_zh:
搜索的账号范围。取值： 
资源目录ID，表示搜索管理账号和所有成员中的资源。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159995.html。
Root资源夹ID，表示搜索Root资源夹及子资源夹下的所有成员中的资源。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html。
资源夹ID，表示搜索指定资源夹下所有成员中的资源。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html。
成员ID，表示搜索指定成员中的资源。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next page of results.

If the total number of results exceeds the MaxResults limit, the data is truncated. You can use NextToken to query the next page of data
parameters.help_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。

当返回结果数据总条数超过`MaxResults`限制，则数据会被截断，您可以使用`NextToken`查询下一页数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。

取值范围：1~100。

默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

fields.help_en: The key of the filter condition. For valid values, see `Supported filter parameters` below
fields.help_zh: 过滤条件键。取值见下方`支持的过滤参数`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The match type.

Set the value to Equals, which indicates an exact match
fields.help_zh:
匹配方式。

取值为Equals，表示相等匹配
fields.name: match_type

fields.help_en: The values of the filter condition
fields.name: value

fields.help_en:
The sorting criterion.

Set the value to CreateTime, which indicates sorting by resource creation time
fields.help_zh:
排序条件。

取值为CreateTime，表示按资源创建时间排序
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The sorting order. Valid values:

ASC (default): ascending order.
DESC: descending order
fields.help_zh:
排序顺序。取值：

ASC（默认值）：升序。
DESC：降序
fields.name: order
